assumptions: Lab bound grants all capped discounts, five free slots, unlimited currencies/Motes and permanent 8x speed from the beginning; one project still cannot run twice concurrently. Actual fresh progression is slower. Small specialized paths may finish earlier intentionally.

forge.name: Battle Focus
forge.description: +8% Lumen from every kill, per level.
forge.decision: Keep historical ranks and their paid effects; future purchases use the listed successor.

forge.name: Shard Sense
forge.description: +8% Shards from every kill, per level.
forge.decision: Keep historical ranks and their paid effects; future purchases use the listed successor.

forge.name: Formation Training
forge.description: +5% passive Wisp damage per level; also raises the Wisp-powered part of your tap damage.
forge.decision: Keep historical ranks and their paid effects; future purchases use the listed successor.

forge.name: Guardian's Resolve
forge.description: +10% tap damage, per level.
forge.decision: Keep historical ranks and their paid effects; future purchases use the listed successor.

forge.name: Swift Recovery
forge.description: +8% faster natural Wisp ability charge per level, up to level 10. Natural ability cycle: at least 3.33 seconds.
forge.decision: Keep bounded cap; charge, regeneration, conversion, resonance or encounter mechanics require finite effect ceilings.

forge.name: Arcane Calibration
forge.description: +3 percentage points to the damaging Wisp ability factor per level. Burst, Breaker, Gale and Thorn only; no passive or Tap bonus.
forge.decision: Keep bounded cap; charge, regeneration, conversion, resonance or encounter mechanics require finite effect ceilings.

forge.name: Resource Conduction
forge.description: +4 percentage points to the ability resource factor per level. Gale Shards and Thorn Lumen only; rounded per cast, not kill rewards.
forge.decision: Keep bounded cap; charge, regeneration, conversion, resonance or encounter mechanics require finite effect ceilings.

forge.name: Luminous Tracking
forge.description: +0.5 percentage points Luminous chance per level for future eligible encounters; total chance at most 35%. No extra Motes per kill.
forge.decision: Keep bounded cap; charge, regeneration, conversion, resonance or encounter mechanics require finite effect ceilings.

forge.name: Masterwork Tempering
forge.description: Adds 5% of base Wisp Power per level, without compounding. Five levels open at Rift 70, then five more every 50 record Rifts. Each level also opens 5 Mastery ranks; their Wisp, Lab, Rift and currency requirements still apply.
forge.decision: Keep 500; additive power and five ranks per 50 record Rifts; last band requires Rift 5020.

forge.name: Cauterize
forge.description: Each level reduces boss regeneration by 2%, up to 20%. Multiplies with the Vanguard Bond.
forge.decision: Keep bounded cap; charge, regeneration, conversion, resonance or encounter mechanics require finite effect ceilings.

forge.name: Fracture Key
forge.description: Each level adds 0.025 to the Fractured Core boss ability multiplier, from 1.75 up to 2. Other enemies are unchanged.
forge.decision: Keep bounded cap; charge, regeneration, conversion, resonance or encounter mechanics require finite effect ceilings.

forge.name: Guardian Seal
forge.description: Each level adds 0.10 to Guardian’s Mark tap damage, from 3 times up to 3.5 times. Applies to manual and Auto-Tap hits.
forge.decision: Keep bounded cap; charge, regeneration, conversion, resonance or encounter mechanics require finite effect ceilings.

forge.name: Rift Spillway
forge.description: Carry 4% of tap or ability overkill per level into the immediately following non-boss. Overkill is bounded by the original hit; never chains or crosses Ascend.
forge.decision: Keep bounded cap; charge, regeneration, conversion, resonance or encounter mechanics require finite effect ceilings.

forge.name: Sustained Channel
forge.description: After a damaging non-Support ability leaves the same boss alive, return 2 charge per level to its caster, up to 10.
forge.decision: Keep bounded cap; charge, regeneration, conversion, resonance or encounter mechanics require finite effect ceilings.

forge.name: Tap Conduit
forge.description: Each manual or Auto-Tap hit gives 2 charge per level to the first powered Active Wisp, up to 10. Charge stops at 100.
forge.decision: Keep bounded cap; charge, regeneration, conversion, resonance or encounter mechanics require finite effect ceilings.

forge.name: Guardian Cadence
forge.description: Every fifth lifetime tap deals 10% extra damage per level, up to 50%. Manual and Auto-Tap share the same count, including across Ascend.
forge.decision: Keep bounded cap; charge, regeneration, conversion, resonance or encounter mechanics require finite effect ceilings.

forge.name: Resonance Relay
forge.description: Support casts give 2 charge per level to each powered non-Support Active Wisp, after ready abilities have fired. Charge stops at 100.
forge.decision: Keep bounded cap; charge, regeneration, conversion, resonance or encounter mechanics require finite effect ceilings.

forge.name: Resonant Edge
forge.description: Support casts also strike for 10% of their own Wisp Power per level. Ability factors apply; Ultimate doubles the hit. Support buffs and its Mote Module do not boost this hit.
forge.decision: Keep bounded cap; charge, regeneration, conversion, resonance or encounter mechanics require finite effect ceilings.

forge.name: Victory Charge
forge.description: Each boss kill gives 4 charge per level to every powered Active Wisp, up to 20. Ascend clears it unless Tree Charge Memory carries a share.
forge.decision: Keep bounded cap; charge, regeneration, conversion, resonance or encounter mechanics require finite effect ceilings.

forge.name: Amplifier Trim
forge.description: Future Support casts gain 1 percentage point of buff strength per level, up to 5. Their durations and already-cast buffs stay unchanged.
forge.decision: Keep bounded cap; charge, regeneration, conversion, resonance or encounter mechanics require finite effect ceilings.

forge.name: Dual Channel
forge.description: Gale also gives Lumen equal to 20% of its native Shards per level; Thorn also gives Shards equal to 2% of its native Lumen per level. Each extra payout rounds down; no repeated conversion.
forge.decision: Keep bounded cap; charge, regeneration, conversion, resonance or encounter mechanics require finite effect ceilings.

forge.name: Overflow Conduit
forge.description: Gale and Thorn gain up to 2% extra native cast resources per level from their original hit’s overkill. The reward fraction cannot exceed overkill divided by that hit; rounds down.
forge.decision: Keep bounded cap; charge, regeneration, conversion, resonance or encounter mechanics require finite effect ceilings.

forge.name: Resonance Cells
forge.description: Each level adds one shared Resonate use per Ascension run, from 3 up to 5. Buying capacity keeps already-spent uses.
forge.decision: Keep bounded cap; charge, regeneration, conversion, resonance or encounter mechanics require finite effect ceilings.

forge.name: Resonance Cascade
forge.description: A paid Resonate refill also gives 2 charge per level to each other powered Active Wisp, up to 10. The selected Wisp still fills to 100.
forge.decision: Keep bounded cap; charge, regeneration, conversion, resonance or encounter mechanics require finite effect ceilings.

forge.name: Resonance Reclaim
forge.description: Each boss kill restores up to one already-spent Resonate use per level, up to 3. Cannot store extra uses beyond the current run capacity.
forge.decision: Keep bounded cap; charge, regeneration, conversion, resonance or encounter mechanics require finite effect ceilings.

forge.name: Battle Tempering
forge.description: +1 percentage point to a separate passive Wisp damage multiplier per level. Also strengthens the Wisp-powered part of tap damage. No final level; prices rise by 10% per level.
forge.decision: No final level; additive effects and growing currency prices continue beyond300.

forge.name: Arcane Tempering
forge.description: +1 percentage point to a separate damaging ability multiplier per level. Includes owned Resonant Edge hits; no ability currencies, Support buff or charge bonus. No final level; prices rise by 10% per level.
forge.decision: No final level; additive effects and growing currency prices continue beyond300.

forge.name: Harvest Tempering
forge.description: +1 percentage point to a separate Lumen and Shard kill-reward multiplier per level. No ability currencies, Motes, Prisms or Sigils. No final level; prices rise by 10% per level.
forge.decision: No final level; additive effects and growing currency prices continue beyond300.

lab.name: Wisp Ascendancy
lab.description: +15% passive Wisp damage permanently; also raises the Wisp-powered part of your tap damage.
lab.decision: Keep 500; long timed foundation.

lab.name: Guardian's Mastery
lab.description: +20% tap damage, permanently.
lab.decision: Keep 500; long timed foundation.

lab.name: Rift Attunement
lab.description: +10% offline earning rate, permanently (stacks past 100%).
lab.decision: Keep historical ranks and paid work; future purchases use the listed successor.

lab.name: Shard Attunement
lab.description: +8% Shards earned per kill, permanently.
lab.decision: Keep 500; long timed foundation.

lab.name: Lumen Wellspring
lab.description: +8% Lumen earned per kill, permanently.
lab.decision: Keep 500; long timed foundation.

lab.name: Formation Insight
lab.description: +5% passive Wisp damage permanently; also raises the Wisp-powered part of your tap damage.
lab.decision: Keep historical ranks and paid work; future purchases use the listed successor.

lab.name: Luminous Sense
lab.description: +10% Motes gained from Luminous enemies, permanently.
lab.decision: Keep 500; long timed foundation.

lab.name: Ascendant Clarity
lab.description: +5% Prisms earned per Ascend, permanently.
lab.decision: Keep historical ranks and paid work; future purchases use the listed successor.

lab.name: Measured Inquiry
lab.description: 2% less work per completed level, up to 20%, for future starts of Wisp Ascendancy, Guardian’s Mastery, Shard Attunement, Lumen Wellspring and Luminous Sense. Running Studies and Measured Inquiry itself are unchanged.
lab.decision: Keep current cap; bounded utility/discount or specialized timed path.

lab.name: Wisp Damage
lab.description: +2% passive Wisp and damaging ability damage per level. Also raises the Wisp-powered part of Guardian Tap; ability resource rewards and Support strength are unchanged.
lab.decision: Keep current cap; bounded utility/discount or specialized timed path.

lab.name: Wisp Critical Chance
lab.description: +0.5 percentage points critical chance per level, up to 50%. Critical damage is averaged evenly across passive Wisp damage and damaging abilities, including offline. No random rolls.
lab.decision: Keep current cap; bounded utility/discount or specialized timed path.

lab.name: Wisp Critical Damage
lab.description: +0.02 critical damage multiplier per level, from 2x to 4x. Needs Wisp Critical Chance to add damage. Averaged into Wisp damage; ability resource rewards and Support strength are unchanged.
lab.decision: Keep current cap; bounded utility/discount or specialized timed path.

lab.name: Expanded Apparatus
lab.description: Earn the fourth and fifth Lab slots through two expansion challenges. Each requires Rift progress, Ascensions and completed research before its timer starts. Existing slots and already-paid work stay.
lab.decision: Keep current cap; bounded utility/discount or specialized timed path.

lab.name: Research Procurement
lab.description: 2% lower Lumen and Shard prices per level for future Lab starts, up to 20%. Does not discount Research Procurement itself or refund running work.
lab.decision: Keep current cap; bounded utility/discount or specialized timed path.

lab.name: Mote Catalysis
lab.description: 2% lower Mote prices per level for future timed Lab boosts, up to 20%. Existing paid speed and boost time are retained; project levels share unexpired boost time.
lab.decision: Keep current cap; bounded utility/discount or specialized timed path.

lab.name: Focused Apparatus
lab.description: At the start of another Study, each unused slot saves 1% work per level, up to 30%. Work is then fixed: filling those slots later cannot change paid work. Does not shorten this project.
lab.decision: Keep current cap; bounded utility/discount or specialized timed path.

lab.name: Field Notes
lab.description: Each earned completion of another Study grants 2 Motes per completed Field Notes level. No reward from this project, rendering, loading or closing over-cap paid work.
lab.decision: Keep current cap; bounded utility/discount or specialized timed path.

lab.name: Balanced Curriculum
lab.description: Each different expansion project with an earned level saves 1% future work per Curriculum level, counting at most ten subjects. Maximum 30%; this project and running work are unchanged.
lab.decision: Keep current cap; bounded utility/discount or specialized timed path.

lab.name: Boss Survey
lab.description: 5% more Lumen and Shards from boss kills per level, up to 100%. Does not change ordinary kills, Sigils, Motes or ability rewards.
lab.decision: Keep current cap; bounded utility/discount or specialized timed path.

lab.name: Luminous Distillation
lab.description: 10% more Lumen and Shards from Luminous kills per level, up to 200%. Does not change encounter chance, Motes, bosses or ability rewards.
lab.decision: Keep current cap; bounded utility/discount or specialized timed path.

lab.name: Sigil Cartography
lab.description: One additional Sigil per boss kill per completed level, up to five. No Sigils from ordinary enemies or ability casts.
lab.decision: Keep current cap; bounded utility/discount or specialized timed path.

lab.name: Rarity Appraisal
lab.description: 2% fewer Shards for future Wisp Rarity upgrades per level, up to 20%. Lumen prices, earned tiers and their effects are unchanged.
lab.decision: Keep current cap; bounded utility/discount or specialized timed path.

lab.name: Module Fabrication
lab.description: 2% lower Lumen and Shard prices for future Wisp Module upgrades per level, up to 20%. Existing Module levels and effects are unchanged.
lab.decision: Keep current cap; bounded utility/discount or specialized timed path.

lab.name: Ultimate Analysis
lab.description: 2% fewer Sigils for future Wisp Ultimate unlocks per level, up to 20%. Mythic requirement and Ultimate effects are unchanged.
lab.decision: Keep current cap; bounded utility/discount or specialized timed path.

lab.name: Resonance Efficiency
lab.description: Each completed level reduces an in-run Resonate refill by 2 Sigils, from 25 down to 15. Unlock conditions, refill amount and run limit are unchanged.
lab.decision: Keep current cap; bounded utility/discount or specialized timed path.

lab.name: Adaptive Growth
lab.description: Each completed level reduces the Wisp level required for a future Rarity upgrade by one, up to five fewer levels. Never below level one; prices and Rarity bonuses are separate.
lab.decision: Keep current cap; bounded utility/discount or specialized timed path.
